clock.application: once before native playback; independent of selected state path

modes.source: all covered native raster pixels partitioned into fine carriers; no probabilistic thinning
modes.target: actual native first-born ink; left-to-right capture front consumes entire available scene pool
modes.semantics: source-only normalized lineage; actual carrier mass, RGB, position and optional momentum interpolate native endpoints; finite independent uniform-increment random walk, not Gaussian Wiener motion or physical CFD
modes.implementation: same canonical native state/material backend; compiled restore/diffusion/carrier/capture GPU programs; no emission, exits, reservoirs or spectral color
modes.emptyEndpoints: removal to blank retains unclaimed stock; empty and matched-only views preserve stock; next first birth consumes it; birth without stock uses plain wave

modes.qualification: plain native alpha front, authored RGB and unit growth; no spectral color or material source

routeStatus.canonicalWasm: current source compiled with pinned canonical075 client compiler
routeStatus.gpu: current source typed IR compiled by pinned GPU emitter; real-f32 execution, qualification tests/material-pool
routeStatus.nativeELF: not qualified for this scene-pool API
routeStatus.renderer: native text binder; generic numerical scene-ink pool; qualification tests/material-pool

batch.sample: dense_vapor_frame plus compiled native restore/diffusion/carrier/capture and finish_dense_capture
batch.coordinateChart: common CSS-height units; native y up
batch.sampleCounts: all raw covered pixels retained; bounded dyadic dispatch <=131072; explicit budget rejection
batch.legacyUnpreparedVapor: not used by scene-pool browser adapter
batch.numeric: same native state/prepare plus renderer forwarding sample_state; one time_coordinate

nativeRecordABI.optionalEncoding: zero-or-one typed named record per applicable group; [] absent
nativeRecordABI.namedFactoryAPI: state/spectral/vapor plus wave(k=4,start=0,finish=1); inapplicable record groups rejected

browserTextBatch.clock: one shared time_coordinate for complete batch
browserTextBatch.identity: exact physical IDs, native bounded monotone correspondence inside explicitly paired authored rows
browserTextBatch.scope: explicit removed scene-ink stock only; current binder supplies native text ink; matched IDs use regular state, first born consumes stock, later births plain wave
browserTextBatch.captureWindow: captureStart/End converted once to shared-clock constants at prepare; entire pool captured by first born completion

continuation.semantics: released unclaimed stock only; opaque immutable snapshot; no-event stock clock paused; same viewport required; no emission/reseed jump

randomPlan.semantics: fresh entropy per new plan; immutable coefficients for arbitrary seek and replay
